messages:
kai: flagging an interoperability glitch seen in prod: function-call payloads sometimes get truncated when SDK 4.1 talks to runtime 4.0. proposing a short dual pin (sdk->4.0, runtime->4.0) for a guarded validation window. thoughts?

deploy-bot: proposed action: dual-pin sdk=4.0 runtime=4.0 scope=hosted,dedicated duration=75m requestor=kai reason='function-call truncation between sdk4.1 and runtime4.0'

tess: can you paste the repro? we need to confirm it's not a client-side framing issue.

kai: repro snippet pasted to thread: `curl -XPOST /v1/call -d '{"fn": "summarize", "input": long_text_chunk}'` -> server logs show partial body read on some streams.

omar: runtime note: we've seen a mismatch in streaming framing when the SDK switched to chunked-json in 4.1. runtime 4.0 expects newline-delimited frames; 4.1 can send mixed framing under backpressure. dual-pin seems reasonable short-term.

infra-lead: ops will only greenlight with auto-unpin and rollback signals. propose rollback: >0.5% absolute increase in function_call_failures or p99 token latency +25% for the canary cohort.

sre-oncall: i'll add alerts and a dashboard: function_call_failures/sec, p99(token_latency), and stream_reorder_count. link coming.

kai: also want to capture a sample of truncated payloads for the infra postmortem; will store to s3 with id tagged.

deploy-bot: pending approvals: runtime,ops. approve via `/deploybot approve-pin 3601234567 --approvers=runtime,ops`

tess: from SDK side: we can keep shim enabled that forces ndjson framing for now, but prefer runtime change long-term. approve from SDK if ops ok.

omar: runtime approves conditional on canary in ap-north-staging only. will run binary sanity: `ci/runtime-sanity --branch=4.0 --check=streaming-framing`

infra-lead: ops approves for ap-north-staging only. global expansion after 30m stable check.

kai: executing canary: 3% traffic in ap-north-staging starting now.

deploy-bot: action: pinned sdk=4.0 runtime=4.0 for model_group=fn-call-heavy in ap-north-staging; canary_traffic=3% started at 3601234575

sre-oncall: 10m snapshot: function_call_failures +0.05%, p99 token latency +2%, stream_reorder_count 0. baseline within thresholds. dashboard: https://grafana.internal/r/fncall-framing-canary

tess: running SDK synthetic that simulates 10k function calls: no truncations observed so far.

kai: 30m update: samples of truncated payloads dropped to zero after pin; looks promising. expanding to 25% in ap-north and 5% in eu-central.

deploy-bot: action: expanded canary at 3601234620 -> ap-north=25% eu-central=5%

omar: one host logged a backpressure-related stream stall but recovered. no user-facing errors. investigating whether autoscale timing caused it.

infra-lead: keep close watch. if we see repeated stream stalls, we'll unpin immediately.

sre-oncall: 45m snapshot: function_call_failures down by 0.1% versus baseline, p99 latency nominal. setting auto-unpin: `/deploybot set-auto-unpin --thread=3601234567 --on-failure=true --targets=ap-north-staging,eu-central-staging`

kai: thanks. docs: can you draft advisory noting "temporary dual pin to align framing semantics; customers relying on custom streaming may see temporary changes"?

docs: drafting a short changelog entry now. will include timeframe and rollback criteria.

kai: canary passed in staging. proposing to schedule global unpin lift (i.e., remove pins) in a maintenance window tomorrow 01:00-02:30 UTC after we push a permanent runtime shim that accepts chunked-json.

tess: SDK team will also prepare a small patch that offers explicit framing toggles for customers if needed. PR will be linked here.

deploy-bot: schedule-rollout command prepared: `/deploybot schedule-rollout --ts=3601320000 --scope=global --note="dual-pin-framing-handshake-rollout"` (ops final)

omar: runtime will have hotfix branch ready to accept mixed framing and log mismatches for 48h post-rollout.

infra-lead: ops thumbs-up for the window. runbook and pager on standby.

kai: thanks everyone. will paste changelog link and PRs once published. tagging @docs for post-roll publish when global completes. :white_check_mark:
